source.locator: About This Survey lines364–367; Q8, Q19, Q22, Q23, Q12

observation.observed_fact: The Dispatch reports987 voluntary responses collected Sep–Oct2026 from its readers and the Daggerheart subreddit. Unanswered questions are omitted per question. Q8 reports79.6% ran DH within the last month; Q19 lists Obsidian27.3%, Q22 lists23.5%.
observation.interpretation: Self-reported GM role and relative recency provide a bounded audience context and tool-use signal; neither total marketGM population nor unmet export demand is measured. Worldbuilding and notes are overlapping constructs.
observation.period: Collection2026-09/2026-10; last-month recency relative to response date, not November retrieval
observation.geography_language: English recruitment; no geographic/language weighting established
limitations: Self-selection via publication and subreddit; not a representative market frame.
Exact per-question n and row-level respondent IDs/cross-tabs not supplied in the read article.
Self-reported recency is not verified sessions or annual survival. No count is inferred by multiplying987 by a percentage.
Content/homebrew preference and map-tool choices do not distinguish new regionalhex creation, battle maps or prepared-setting use.
No switching/export unmet-need question identified; existing tool use does not prove willingness to switch.

Q8.unit: percent of answers to recency question

Q19.unit: percent of answers to worldbuilding question

Q22.unit: percent of answers to note-taking question

observation.additional_read_context: Q12 homebrew25.5% is material preference; Q23 mixes map approaches. Neither is p_create.

read_scope: Methods and selected GM recency/tool/content/map questions; no raw respondent dataset downloaded.
source_wording_vs_product: Survey records existing use; a one-way export is our proposal. It was not a demand question in the survey.
rating_disposition: No new M/p/T/R/C or rank proposed. The new source merits attention despite lower currentrank, but cannot convert a convenience sample into a world population.
